title: Table filters
summary: A debounced global search box plus a Filters trigger (with an active-count badge) that opens a panel around your own filter fields, so a data table or list gets consistent search/filter UI without every page rebuilding the trigger-button-plus-badge-plus-panel shell by hand. Slot your own filter fields (selects, date ranges, whatever the fields are) into the default slot; put the element itself in pk-table's toolbar slot. It never searches, filters or clears anything itself: it only reports pk-search, pk-toggle and pk-clear-filters for the host to act on, the same as pk-table's own pk-sort and pk-filter.

props.name: label
props.description: The search box's placeholder and accessible name.

props.name: debounce
props.description: Milliseconds between the last keystroke and pk-search.

props.name: filterCount
props.description: Active-filter count shown as a badge on the Filters trigger. The host counts its own slotted fields; 0 hides the badge.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the filter panel is open. The user opens and closes it with the Filters trigger and the panel's close button, and the element raises pk-toggle; a change the host makes raises nothing.

slots.description: Your own filter fields (selects, date ranges, text inputs), shown in the filter panel. The Filters trigger only appears once this slot has content.

events.name: pk-toggle
events.description: The filter panel was opened or closed. open already holds the new state.

events.name: pk-clear-filters
events.description: Clear filters was activated in the panel. The host owns the slotted fields; it clears their own state.

parts.name: body
parts.description: The panel's body, holding the default slot

parts.name: footer
parts.description: The panel's footer, holding Clear filters

a11y: The search box is labelled by label. The Filters trigger reflects aria-expanded; the panel is a normal document region (not a modal: no focus trap, no backdrop), so the page behind stays usable. The close button is labelled Close filters.
mobile: The search box grows to full width; the trigger, close and clear buttons are 44px.

examples.title: In a table's toolbar
examples.html:
<pk-table columns='[{"key":"sku","label":"SKU"}]' rows='[{"id":1,"sku":"AC-001"}]'>
  <pk-table-filters slot="toolbar" label="Search products" filter-count="1">
    <pk-select label="Category"><option>Accessories</option></pk-select>
  </pk-table-filters>
</pk-table>
